purpose: Discover a first fully local OCR perception provider on macOS and validate the observation shape, text recognition and capture-pixel bounding-box coordinate conversion without integrating the provider into Computer Use or executing any action.
requiredClaims: the real P1B mapped-frame path supplies the PNG used for interpretation
the OCR probe uses the local macOS Vision framework and receives image bytes through stdin
two fixed test-owned strings are recognized without logging recognized text
OCR bounding boxes are converted from Vision normalized lower-left coordinates to capture-pixel top-left coordinates
both recognized box centers map through the physically validated P1B transform into their independently known logical test-owned windows
OCR outputs remain observations and do not claim semantic UI identity
no network API, remote model or external account is used by the probe
no pointer, click, drag, wheel or keyboard action is performed
frame payload, recognized text and coordinates are not persisted or logged
fixture and Computer Control runtime are cleaned up
nonClaims: macOS Vision is not yet a Computer Use product provider
no cross-platform OCR provider contract is frozen by this discovery alone
no VLM or general object detector is validated
recognized text does not prove semantic identity or task success
no action derived from OCR is executed
no arbitrary user-content OCR accuracy claim is made
